scope: Actual Express/JWT/PostgreSQL with synthetic cases; deadline consistency only, no current-law/claimant/filing proof
checks: Anonymous, client and foreign-company creation denied by actual HTTP authority
Case, derived tenant, zero fee, cryptographic token, deadlines and audit commit together
Malformed amounts, invalid calendar date and forged server-owned fields create no case
Concurrent manual and trusted service creators share unique sequential codes
Deleting a just-created synthetic case does not reuse its issued code
Concurrent and lost-response retries reuse one durable request receipt; changed input conflicts
Actual AuditLog failure rolls back case, allocation counter and dependent writes
Actual Deadline failure rolls back case, allocation counter and dependent writes
Malformed durable counter fails closed instead of resetting case numbers
Actual ingestion creator uses the same durable allocator and transactional deadline writer
